policy: Only verified entries may inform guidance. Unverified entries are research leads and must never change scoring, gates, or recommendations.

verified.title: June 2026 spam update
verified.summary: Latest confirmed ranking event as of verification; rollout lasted 2 days and 1 hour. Dashboard dates do not establish site-level causation.

verified.title: Canonicalization reevaluation timing clarified
verified.summary: Google may keep corrected pages in a duplicate cluster for up to two weeks; Request Indexing is quota-limited and should be reserved for important URLs.

verified.title: Search Console platform properties
verified.summary: Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube platform properties are rolling out gradually with Search and Discover performance views. API support is not promised.

verified.title: AMP links open on publisher hosts
verified.summary: Google Search now links directly to publisher-hosted AMP pages. AMP remains supported and ranks like other pages but is not required.

verified.title: Search Console generative AI reports
verified.summary: Separate Search and Discover views show generative-AI impressions plus page, country, device where applicable, and date dimensions. The rollout is limited and no dedicated API is documented.

verified.title: Preferred Sources in AI Mode and AI Overviews
verified.summary: Reader-selected domains and subdomains may receive preferred treatment or badges for that reader. This is optional audience development, not a general ranking signal.

verified.title: Google Search I/O 2026 product updates
verified.summary: AI Mode uses Gemini 3.5 Flash globally and adds conversational, multimodal, and agentic capabilities. These announcements are not ranking factors.

verified.title: Generative AI optimization guide
verified.summary: Google says generative AI optimization is foundational SEO: create non-commodity content and avoid chunking myths, special AI schema, and scaled fan-out pages.

verified.title: FAQ rich results retired
verified.summary: FAQ rich results are no longer shown in Google Search. FAQPage may remain schema.org-valid but provides no Google rich-result or generative-AI advantage.

verified.title: Explore the web with generative AI
verified.summary: Google described deeper article links, public discussions, inline links, and previews. These are product features, not content-scoring factors.

verified.title: Read more deep-link guidance
verified.summary: Target content should be immediately visible; scripts should not reset scroll position or remove the hash on page load.

verified.title: Back-button hijacking spam policy
verified.summary: Deceptive browser-history interference became an explicit malicious-practices violation. Detection must be based on obstructive behavior, not normal History API syntax.

verified.title: Discussion Forum and QAPage properties clarified
verified.summary: QAPage remains a narrow supported type for a page focused on one question where users can submit answers; it is not a replacement for editorial FAQ content.

verified.title: Discover content and preferred-image guidance
verified.summary: Discover requires no special schema. Preferred images are at least 1200px wide, over 300,000 pixels, preferably 16:9, relevant, and enabled for large previews.

verified.title: Googlebot file-size limits clarified
verified.summary: Googlebot processes the first 2MB of supported files and first 64MB of PDFs, using uncompressed size; later bytes are ignored.

verified.title: Core update analysis guidance
verified.summary: Wait a full week after rollout, compare the correct periods, separate Web, Image, Video, and News performance, and avoid quick fixes or mass deletion.

verified.title: JavaScript-generated structured data guidance
verified.summary: Google can process structured data generated with JavaScript when it is present in the rendered DOM and validated against the visible page.

verified.title: Retired structured data Search experiences
verified.summary: Course Info, Estimated Salary, Learning Video, SpecialAnnouncement, and Vehicle Listing were removed as Google Search experiences. ClaimReview was part of the same simplification; PracticeProblem was removed in January 2026. Course list and schema.org validity are separate.
